CustomField.description: Implant growth $ plus disposables growth $ for this surgeon; the deal's ROSA Growth $ adds these up. Implants: ZB with ROSA minus ZB now. Disposables: all ZB cases with ROSA. Calculated automatically. Read-only.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Calculated automatically: implant growth (ZB with ROSA minus ZB now) times the implant price, plus every ZB case with ROSA times the disposables price, for the deal's country and currency. Read-only.
CustomField.label: Growth $
